newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends down on greenback's rise overseas.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends down on greenback's rise overseas.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against its U.S. counterpart on Tuesday, reflecting the greenback's rise overseas against the Japanese yen, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.934 against Monday's T$27.918 finish.
Turnover through dealers was active at US$288 million.
Dealers said they expected the rate to remain in consolidation in the near term.
"The U.S. dollar's mild rise against the yen triggered some demand for it in Taiwan's market, but the local currency still showed strong support," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A T$27.91-94 range was seen for Wednesday.
